mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving-hatch passage is a satisfying close: the specimens reach other hands, and the final question keeps the discovery alive.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no playable action in this chapter; I would have liked a little more involvement in the arrival.

surprise.text: The ending focuses on sharing the discovery rather than explaining what the specimens are. I was curious about the answer, but the uncertainty feels appropriate.

arbitrary.text: No action in this chapter felt arbitrary; there were no actions to choose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the receiving scientists learn, though this ending also works as a stopping point.
